policy: References informed growth form, corallite size and spacing, calice inclination, colony size and pigment placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, tracing or proportion source; trade names (chalice, eyes) guided identity only.
taxonomyNote: The aquarium trade name 'chalice coral' covers several laminar / encrusting genera. Echinophyllia and Oxypora are placed in Lobophylliidae and Mycedium in Merulinidae (WoRMS, following Huang et al. 2014 and 2016; the former family Pectiniidae was abolished). The asset therefore carries a group-level scientific label with taxonomyConfidence 'group'.

sources.title: Echinophyllia Klunzinger, 1879 genus record (Lobophylliidae) with diagnosis: colonial, laminar; calice width medium to large (>= 4 mm), low to medium relief (<= 6 mm)

Echinophyllia aspera (Ellis & Solander, 1786) species record: encrusting to foliaceous, sometimes 60 cm across; corallites mostly flush to protuberant, calices facing upwards; colonies hug the surface closely (Sheppard, 1998)
Mycedium elephantotus (Pallas, 1766) species record (Merulinidae): corallites clearly face towards the perimeter of the plates; septo-costae radiate to the colony perimeter (Richmond, 1997)
Echinophyllia aspera trait record: growth form laminar, corallite width 8.8 mm (min) to 10.9 mm (max)
Huang D, Benzoni F, Fukami H, Knowlton N, Smith ND, Budd AF (2014) Taxonomic classification of the reef coral families Merulinidae, Montastraeidae, and Diploastraeidae. Zool J Linn Soc 171: 277-355

referenceGradeRationale: Growth form, colony size, corallite width and calice inclination are documented by WoRMS species descriptions and the Coral Trait Database; openly licensed top-view photographs exist for the genera. Plate thickness, margin lift and feeding-tentacle length are inferred from the group's general laminar habit rather than measured on a calibrated side view, and aquarium pigment variants are cultivar colour morphs without a taxonomic reference.
